dogecoin.text: Earlier this month, Musk teased #DOGE payments on Twitter in a tweet, proposing #Dogecoin as one of the payment options for Twitter Blue, the platform’s subscription service with premium features.

Kryptomon Chief Marketing Officer Tomer Nuni explained that there were speculations that advertisers could be able to pay #dogecoin for ads and for other uses on Twitter, citing Tesla as one similar case where Musk’s businesses and stakeholdings started to accept #crypto.

In addition to being a #Dogecoin influencer, Musk’s Tesla is one of the biggest corporate buyers of #bitcoin. Those who hope to see Twitter integrate more #crypto features will be keeping an eye on whether or how Musk prioritizes crypto.
